scope: Library component promotion only; no runnable desktop host, GUI, native engine, model or installed-agent acceptance

promotion.runtime: Only qualify local imports to adaptive_inference.desktop; no executable behavior change
promotion.tests: Canonical imports; ordinary shared fixture imports instead of dynamic private path loading; unchanged selected test methods except the exact GUI objective constant substitution in transport-progress setup
promotion.mailbox_tests: Retain DataFixture, FakeLifecycle and 27 RuntimeTests; the five SnapshotTests already exist in the canonical suite
promotion.progress_tests: Retain ProgressTests, PolicyTests, TransportProgressTests and the first SafeBoundaryTests method; defer actual GUI-client serialization, desktop facade projection and two full-runner evidence tests until their components are promoted
promotion.test_support: One unmodified-behavior foreground policy consumer with qualified imports, under tests/desktop_support only; original strict policy is the canonical adaptive_inference.handoff module
promotion.predecessor_policy: Canonical ForegroundPolicy and number helper are AST-identical to the selected packet predecessor/handoff.py; no duplicate predecessor copy is added
promotion.private_manifests: The complete private manifest includes local paths and is not copied; all selected implementation and test source bytes are retained here

license: Original Apache-2.0 project code; existing TaskStore and policy reuse attribution remains in NOTICE and third_party; no new upstream implementation copied
